title: Program Overview
content: We offer three flagship programs (all fictional sample data). The Academy program is a 6-month full-stack and DSA track with 3 live classes per week. The Data Science program runs 9 months and covers Python, statistics, ML and MLOps. The DevOps program runs 7 months covering Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD and cloud on AWS.

title: Fees and EMI Options
content: Program fees are Academy ₹3,50,000, Data Science ₹2,85,000 and DevOps ₹1,80,000 inclusive of GST. No-cost EMI is available for 6, 12 and 18 months through partner lenders, subject to credit approval. A one-time booking amount of ₹10,000 locks your seat and is adjusted against the final fee. Longer tenures such as 18 months may carry a small processing fee of ₹999.

title: Refund Policy
content: Learners get a 100% refund if requested within 7 days of enrollment and a 50% refund if requested between day 8 and day 14. No refund is available after 14 days. Refunds above ₹10,000 require manager approval before processing. Approved refunds are credited to the original payment method within 7-10 business days.

title: Admission Process and Eligibility
content: Admission starts with an online screening test of 60 minutes covering basic logic and programming aptitude. Shortlisted candidates then have a 20-minute counselling call to match them to the right program. Graduates and working professionals with at least a bachelor's degree are eligible. Offer letters are issued within 2 business days of a successful counselling call.

title: Scholarships
content: Merit scholarships of 10% to 30% of the program fee are awarded based on screening test score. A women-in-tech scholarship of up to ₹25,000 is available each cohort. Scholarships cannot be combined with other discounts and must be claimed before enrollment. Scholarship decisions are made by the admissions committee and are final.

title: Class Schedule and Live Sessions
content: Weekday batches run Monday to Wednesday, 8:00 PM to 10:00 PM IST. Weekend batches run Saturday and Sunday, 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM IST. Live class links are available on the learner dashboard 15 minutes before each session. Holiday schedule changes are announced by email at least 3 days in advance.

title: Session Recordings
content: Recordings of every live class are uploaded to the dashboard within 24 hours. Learners have access to recordings for 12 months from the batch start date. Recordings can be played at up to 2x speed and include searchable timestamps. If a recording is missing after 24 hours, support can raise a request with the content team.

title: Mentor Sessions and Rescheduling
content: Each learner gets a 1:1 mentor session of 45 minutes every two weeks. Sessions can be rescheduled from the dashboard up to 6 hours before the slot at no charge. Learners can reschedule up to 3 times per month; further changes need support approval. If a mentor cancels, a replacement slot is offered within 72 hours.

title: Assignments and Deadline Extensions
content: Assignments are released weekly and are due 7 days after release. Learners can request one extension of up to 3 days per module with a valid reason such as illness or work travel. Extensions beyond 3 days require approval from the program manager. Late submissions without an extension lose 10% of the score per day.

title: Placement Support
content: Placement support includes resume reviews, 4 mock interviews, LinkedIn profile coaching and referrals to hiring partners. Support is available for 12 months after program completion. We do not offer or guarantee any job, salary or specific outcome. Referrals depend on learner performance and employer openings.

title: Certificates
content: A certificate of completion is issued to learners who attend at least 75% of live classes and score 60% or more on the capstone project. Certificates are emailed as a PDF within 10 business days of final evaluation. A verification link is included for employers. Name corrections can be requested once through support with a government ID.

title: Platform Login and Password Reset
content: Use the Forgot Password link on the login page to receive a reset email valid for 30 minutes. If the email does not arrive, check spam and confirm you are using your enrolled email address. Accounts are temporarily locked for 15 minutes after 5 failed attempts. Support can update your registered email only after verifying your phone number via OTP.

title: Switching Batches and Pausing the Program
content: Learners can switch to another batch once, free of charge, if requested at least 7 days before the new batch start. A program can be paused for up to 3 months, once only, after which the learner rejoins the next available batch. Pause requests need the program manager's approval and are not allowed during the final capstone month. Recordings access is extended by the pause duration.

title: Invoices and GST
content: Tax invoices are generated automatically after each payment and emailed within 48 hours. GST at 18% is included in the listed program fee. To add a company GSTIN, request it within 15 days of payment with the legal entity name and address. Duplicate invoices can be downloaded from the Payments section of the dashboard.

title: Technical Issues and Video Lag
content: For video lag, first check that your connection is at least 5 Mbps and switch to 480p or 720p in the player settings. Close other bandwidth-heavy apps and try Chrome or Edge in an updated version. If the issue affects many learners, check the status page for ongoing incidents. Persistent problems should be escalated to the technical team with a screenshot and speed test.

title: Data Privacy and Account Deletion
content: Requests to delete an account or personal data are handled only by the dedicated privacy team and must never be processed by general support. Support should acknowledge the request and route it to privacy@example.com. The privacy team verifies identity and completes requests within 30 days. Deletion removes access to the dashboard, recordings and certificates.
